g.text: Stacked bars: extension value added as a share of full World Bank agricultural VA (black dashed line = 100%).
Grey tick = FABIO-comparable WB (WB minus seeds and forestry); coloured square = forestry source (see
legend). Items below 3% |share| per country are grouped as "Other". Countries ordered by WB ag VA, largest
first. Axis follows the data; overshoot beyond 300% is shown in full. Primary (ISIC-A) layer only.
COMBINED-EXIOBASE extension vs World Bank agricultural value added (full WB), 2022
